cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Places and Ways.

words.en: We need cheap accommodation.
words.scene: Mum and Dad looking at a small, clean guesthouse with flowers in the window, suitcases on the ground.
more: Our hotel has good accommodation.
我们的酒店住宿条件很好。
They found accommodation for the night.
他们找到了当晚的住处。

words.en: Look at the aeroplane in the sky!
words.scene: A large white passenger aeroplane flying high in a blue sky with fluffy clouds, Lily pointing up from a grassy hill.
more: The aeroplane is very big.
这架飞机很大。
We travel by aeroplane to London.
我们坐飞机去伦敦。

words.en: London is the capital of England.
words.scene: A map of Britain with London marked by a red star, Lily pointing at it while Dad holds a travel guide.
more: We live in the capital city.
我们住在首都城市。
The capital is very busy.
这座城市很繁忙。

words.en: Our city has many tall buildings.
words.sz: 我们的城市有很多高楼。
words.scene: A view of a busy city with skyscrapers, cars on the road below, and a park in the foreground where Lily is walking Max.
more: I live in a big city.
我住在一个大城市。
Grandma lives far from the city.
奶奶住在离城市很远的地方。

words.en: We walk along the coast.
words.scene: A family walking on a sandy path next to the blue sea, waves crashing gently on the shore, seagulls flying above.
more: The coast is beautiful in summer.
夏天海岸很美。
They live near the coast.
他们住在海岸附近。

words.en: Lily plays tennis on the court.
words.scene: A green tennis court with white lines, Lily holding a racket ready to serve, Mia opposite her.
more: The basketball court is full.
篮球场很热闹。
We have football practice on the court.
我们在球场上进行足球训练。

words.en: Wait at the crossing.
words.scene: Lily and Tom standing on a pavement waiting to cross, a clear zebra crossing with white stripes on the road in front of them.
more: Look left and right at the crossing.
在人行横道处向左看和向右看。
The traffic lights are near the crossing.
交通灯在人行横道附近。

words.en: Dad goes to the drugstore.
words.scene: Mum buying medicine at a counter in a shop, shelves of health products behind the assistant.
more: There is a drugstore next to the bank.
银行旁边有一家药店。
Buy some soap at the drugstore.
在药店买一些肥皂。

words.en: Dad stops at the gas station.
words.scene: A car parked next to a fuel pump, Dad holding the nozzle, a sign with no readable text in the background.
more: The gas station is closed now.
加油站现在关门了。
We need petrol at the gas station.
我们需要在加油站加汽油。

words.en: The boats are in the harbour.
words.scene: Several small fishing boats tied to a wooden dock, calm blue water, seagulls sitting on the posts.
more: We watched the ships leave the harbour.
我们看着船只离开港口。
The harbour is very quiet at night.
港口在夜里很安静。

words.en: A big lorry drives past.
words.scene: A large red delivery lorry on a road, Lily and Tom waving at it from the sidewalk.
more: The lorry carries heavy boxes.
这辆卡车装着很重的箱子。
That blue lorry is very long.
那辆蓝色卡车很长。

words.en: We go to the movie theater.
words.scene: Lily, Tom and their parents sitting in red cinema seats eating snacks, a large screen showing a cartoon animal.
more: The movie theater is big.
这家电影院很大。
We eat chips at the movie theater.
我们在电影院吃薯片。

words.en: Dad parks the car in the parking lot.
words.scene: A paved area with several cars parked in marked spaces, Dad locking his blue car while Lily waits nearby.
more: The parking lot is full.
停车场满了。
Find a space in the parking lot.
在停车场找一个车位。

words.en: A police car drives by.
words.scene: A white and blue police car with flashing lights on top, a friendly police officer waving at Lily.
more: The police car is very fast.
这辆警车很快。
Sam likes the big police car.
Sam 喜欢那辆大警车。

words.en: Big ships come into the busy port.
words.scene: A busy port with big ships, cranes and containers stacked high, seagulls flying.
more: We saw many boats in the port.
我们在港口看到了很多船。
The ship left the port this morning.
这艘船今天早上离开了港口。

words.en: Mum goes to the shopping centre.
words.scene: A large modern building with glass doors, Mum walking inside carrying shopping bags.
more: The shopping centre is very big.
这个购物中心很大。
We buy clothes at the shopping centre.
我们在购物中心买衣服。

words.en: They are building a house on this site.
words.sz: 他们正在这块地上盖房子。
words.scene: A building site with a half-built house, a crane and workers in yellow hats.
more: This is a good site for games.
这是一个适合玩游戏的好网站。
The school is on a quiet site.
学校在一个安静的地方。

words.en: The bus is cheap transport.
words.sz: 公共汽车是便宜的交通工具。
words.scene: Lily and Mum standing at a bus stop waiting for a red double-decker bus, Tom holding his ticket.
more: The train is fast transport.
火车是一种快速的交通工具。
There is no transport here late at night.
深夜这里没有交通工具。

words.en: Can you give me directions?
words.scene: Sam asking a friendly police officer for help, the officer pointing down the street.
more: I need directions to the park.
我需要去公园的路线指引。
Follow these directions carefully.
仔细跟着这些指引走。

words.en: Mum reads a guidebook.
words.sz: 妈妈在读一本旅游指南。
words.scene: The family on holiday, Mum sitting on a bench reading a book with pictures of landmarks, Lily pointing at a statue.
more: This guidebook has good photos.
这本指南有很多好看的照片。
We found the hotel in the guidebook.
我们在指南里找到了那家酒店。

words.en: Dad runs one mile every day.
more: The shop is half a mile away.
商店在半英里外。
We walked two miles to the lake.
我们走了两英里到湖边。

words.en: The view from the hill is great.
words.sz: 从山上看到的景色很棒。
words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max standing on top of a grassy hill looking out at a beautiful valley with houses and trees below.
more: I like the view from my window.
我喜欢我窗外的景色。
The sea view is very blue.
海景非常蓝。

words.en: This is a nice place for a picnic.
words.sz: 这是一个适合野餐的好地方。
words.scene: The family having a picnic on a checkered blanket in a sunny garden, eating sandwiches and fruit.
more: Let's go to my favourite place.
我们去我最喜欢的地方吧。
Is this the right place for the bus?
这是坐公交车的正确地点吗？

words.en: The ball is on the ground.
words.scene: Tom picking up a football from the grassy school playground, other children playing in the distance.
more: Don't sit on the cold ground.
不要坐在冰冷的地面上。
We play games on the school ground.
我们在学校操场上玩游戏。

words.en: Dad works in the sales department.
words.scene: Dad sitting at an office desk with a computer, wearing a shirt and tie, talking on the phone.
more: The toy department is downstairs.
玩具专柜在楼下。
Which department are you in?
你在哪个部门？

words.en: Mum gets a discount at the shop.
words.sz: 妈妈在商店得到了折扣。
more: Students get a small discount.
学生可以享受一点折扣。
Is there a discount on this book?
这本书有折扣吗？

words.en: There is a big sale in the town.
words.scene: A shop window full of colourful clothes and shoes, Mum looking excited, Lily holding her hand.
more: The shoes are on sale today.
这些鞋子今天减价出售。
We like shopping during the sale.
我们喜欢在减价活动期间购物。
